requiredBehaviors.behavior: separate confirmed meeting facts from objectives, decisions, open questions, risks, and preparation actions
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow fixes meeting facts first and models objectives, decisions, questions, risks, and actions as separate output sections.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve evidence-note claim provenance, confidence, and contradictions
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Evidence focusing explicitly retains claim IDs, source references, confidence, and conflicts from research-to-evidence-note.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: produce a concise immediately usable meeting brief without duplicating retrieval logic
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill starts from confirmed connector/tool outputs and ends in a 30-second brief plus focused preparation rather than implementing retrieval.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: invent participant motives or unverified authority
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Participant context is limited to verified meeting-relevant roles and responsibilities.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: claim calendar, contact, or document actions were executed
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Connector work remains out of scope and pending preparation actions cannot be represented as completed.
